_doc.about: Your own rules for web-unlock-guard. Created by the plugin on its first run; plugin updates never touch it. Both lists start empty, which behaves exactly like having no file. Keys starting with _ are notes and are ignored. Full example: examples/rules.example.json in the plugin repo.
_doc.webish: Extra tool names that make a command count as web work. A word ("my-scraper-cli") or {"word": "mcporter", "layer": "fetch-render"} so its blocks count strikes under that method. Layers: http, fetch-render, fetch-unlock, browser-automation, browser-cft, browser-stealth, browser-real, browser-cloud.
_doc.deny: Extra deny rules for PreToolUse: {"name", "pattern" (JavaScript regex), "flags", "unless" (regex), "tools" (regex on the tool name), "message"}. {skill_dir} in the message becomes the companion skill folder.
_doc.other_options: max_strikes (2), sites_file, skill_dir and rules_file are plugin options, set with /plugin configure web-unlock-guard@lucas-plugins or WEB_UNLOCK_GUARD_* environment variables, not in this file.
